title: PaymentStatusResponse
description: Response fields of the Payments Response.

paymentId.description: Unique identifier for the payment submission request.

paymentType.description: The type of transaction that was initiated.

paymentStatus.description:
The status of the transaction. Possible values for RTP are RECEIVED - The payment has been received for processing. IN_PROGRESS - The payment processing is in progress. COMPLETED - The payment has been completed. REJECTED - The payment has been rejected.
Possible values for ACH are RECEIVED - API payment request received and staged for exported. EXPORTED - API payment request exported for backend processing system. ACKNOWLEDGED - Backend processing system acknowledged receipt of payment.

rejectCode.description: The rejection code in case the transaction was rejected

rejectDescription.description: The description for the rejection code

receivedDateTime.description: The date and time when the payment transaction was received.

statusDateTime.description: The date and time when the status was updated.

networkInstructionId.description: The network assigned payment reference number.
